huecos.plato: grilled octopus with prawns and boiled potatoes
huecos.elementos: one curled grilled octopus tentacle with charred suckers, peeled cooked prawns with tails dusted with paprika, sliced boiled yellow potatoes glistening with oil and paprika, drizzled green chopped parsley oil, all served on the round grooved light wooden serving board
huecos.recuento: Exactly one octopus tentacle, three whole prawns and one round wooden board.

camara.descripcion: slightly high three-quarter angle rotated 45 degrees so the entire wooden board sits fully inside the frame with generous margin on the left and top

huecos.ideaGrafica: Dish placed in the lower-right half with the whole wooden board uncut, angled so the curled tentacle leads the eye toward a wide clean empty zone on the left for vertical typography
huecos.luz: Bright, even studio light from the upper right casting a crisp, short contact shadow under the board and popping specular highlights on the oil, paprika and octopus suckers
huecos.colorDominante: Clean neutral seamless studio backdrop for cutout; warm golden wood, bright yellow potatoes, green herb oil and rich paprika-red octopus as the punchy colours

decisiones: Se eliminan de la lista el bajoplato, el mantel y el vaso porque son ruido del fondo y la estética Color pop con recorte exige solo el plato en su tabla sobre fondo uniforme.
Se cambia a plano MEDIO en tres cuartos a 45° y giro de 45° para cumplir el cambio de toma (>30°) y mostrar la tabla entera sin cortes.
Se sitúa el plato abajo a la derecha dejando el hueco limpio a la izquierda, replicando la retícula vertical de ref-post-16.
